headline: European Union foresees investments of 5,000 million euros in Mexico: Christophe Hansen
summary: European Agriculture Commissioner Christophe Hansen began an official visit to Mexico with 120 business representatives. The EU expects investments of €5 billion in Mexico.
why: EU investment flows into Mexico support manufacturing and agri-food supply chains, and they are an important source of foreign direct investment.
original_headline: Unión Europea prevé inversiones por 5,000 millones de euros en México: Christophe Hansen
